mostWorthwhile.text: Forming two daughter nuclei before dividing the cytoplasm was the most worthwhile passage: the connected cell and shallow furrow made those separate events clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing membrane and then adding it felt somewhat repetitive, especially with only one combination offered at each step. The ER and Golgi inset also locates the vesicles without explaining their roles.

surprise.text: The spindle was shown as assembling during mitosis after DNA copying, even though I selected its construction before enlarging the cell. That timing caption helped distinguish the model's preparation sequence from cellular timing.

arbitrary.text: Combining generic new cell proteins with duplicated centrosomes to make a spindle felt somewhat compressed: the result labels tubulin and a motor protein, but does not explain how they assemble into the spindle.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: the separate nuclear and cytoplasmic division steps were informative, and the promised differentiation into lining, muscle and nerve cells offers an interesting next direction.
